title: Whereabouts V. N. Palitza

page_data.en:
Fm. 2.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE GENERAL REGISTRY. File No. D 5408）
REPORT
SECTION 2
Date November 11, 1933

Subject (in full) Whereabouts of V.N.Palitza

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the endorsement of the Offr i/c
Special Branch on the attached report dated November 2,1933, on
the subject of V.N.Palitza ( file D-5408 ) I have to state that
this individual had no fixed employment during the current year
and worked as a commission agent on a small scale. Following the
outbreak of the present strike at the Shanghai Power Company he
was temporarily engaged by that concern as a mechanic, but was
dismissed on or about October 16 for that " he had absented him-
self on the previous night without first obtaining leave".

Palitza resided in House 2, Passage 106 Route Vallon.
until September 1,1933 when he was obliged to vacate the room
he occupied at that address owing to non-payment of two months'
rent in arrears. At the time he was employed with the Shanghai
Power Company he gave his address as No 587 Avenue Joffre. En-
quiries show, however, that he is not known to the occupants of
those premises. His present whereabouts are not known even to his
sister.

It is likely that he left Shanghai for the South, as
he stated, his intention was when applying for a certificate of
registration with the Russian Emigrants Committee on October 26.

a. Prokofiev
D.S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
[签名]
12 1933

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处总登记处。档案号 D 5408）
报告
第二科
日期 1933年11月11日

主题（全称） V.N.帕利察（V.N.Palitza）的下落

制作人 D.S.普罗科菲耶夫 转呈人 [签名]

关于特别分支负责人在附件中1933年11月2日有关V.N.帕利察（档案号 D-5408）的报告上的批注，本人须陈述如下：该人在本年度没有固定职业，从事小规模佣金代理工作。在上海电力公司当前罢工爆发后，他被该公司临时雇用为技工，但于10月16日左右被解雇，理由是“他前一晚在未获准假的情况下擅自缺勤”。

帕利察居住在瓦隆路（Route Vallon）106弄2号，直至1933年9月1日，因拖欠两个月租金，被迫搬离其在该地址居住的房间。他在上海电力公司任职期间，提供的地址是霞飞路587号。然而调查显示，该住所的住户并不认识他。甚至他的姐姐也不知道他目前的下落。

他很可能已如他所言离开上海前往南方，因为他在10月26日向俄国侨民委员会申请注册证明书时曾表明此意向。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
D.S.

特别分支负责人。
[签名]
1933年11月12日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. REGISTRY.
SECTION 2 5408
REPORT
Date November 2, 1933

Subject (in full) V.N.Palitza, alleged Bolshevick agitator.

Made by D.S. Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached report of P.S.Maximoff
(Wayside) dated October 25,1933,on the subject of Nicolas Palitza,
who is alleged to be a "Bolshevick agitator",I have to state that
the correct name of the individual referred to is Vitali N.Palitza.
He first came to the notice of this office in April,
1932, when he applied for a position as a Police Watchman. As
the same name with different initials was mentioned in the lists
of active members of the Soviet controlled Professional Unions in
the Chinese Eastern Railway area,the applicant was requested to
attend this office for an interview regarding his antecedents.
However, he failed to comply with this request. General informa-
tion available at that time regarding his character was also not
in his favour and ,therefore, his application was not considered.
On May 23,1932,he was charged before the 2-nd Shanghai
Special District Court with embezzlement and was sentenced to
six months imprisonment,suspended for two years, and to pay the
complainant the sum of M.$.1050. On December23,1932, he appeared
before the same court on a similar charge,but this time the case
against him was dismissed. According to our information Palitza
also committed several petty frauds which have not been reported
to the police;
A.F. Maltzeff, residing in House 28,No 613 Avenue Joffre,
who informed P.S.Maximoff regarding Palitza's alleged activity
as a Bolshevick agitator, and A.F.Levchenko,residing at No 520
Route Vallon,who is also temporarily employed with the Shanghai
Power Co, were interviewed by the undersigned. Apart from stating
that Palitza on several occasions prior to his employment with
the Shanghai Power Co expressed,during the course of casual con-
versations with them, his pro-Soviet attitude and mentioned that

报告
日期 1933年11月2日

主题（全称） V.N.帕利察，涉嫌布尔什维克煽动者。

制作人 D.S. 普罗科菲耶夫 转呈人 [签名]

关于附件中P.S.马克西莫夫（路边巡捕房）于1933年10月25日提交的有关尼古拉斯·帕利察（Nicolas Palitza）的报告，此人被指称为“布尔什维克煽动者”，本人须陈述如下：所述人员的正确姓名为维塔利·N.帕利察（Vitali N.Palitza）。
他首次引起本处注意是在1932年4月，当时他申请担任警员职位。由于在中东铁路地区受苏联控制的职业工会活跃成员名单中提到了同名但首字母不同的人，因此要求申请人到本处接受关于其背景的问询。然而，他未遵从这一要求。当时掌握的关于其品行的一般信息也对他不利，因此，他的申请未被考虑。
1932年5月23日，他在上海第二特区地方法院被指控犯有侵占罪，并被判处六个月监禁，缓刑两年，并赔偿原告洋1050元。1932年12月23日，他因类似指控再次出庭同一法院，但此次针对他的案件被驳回。根据我方掌握的信息，帕利察还实施了几起未向警方报案的小额诈骗；
居住在霞飞路613号28室的A.F.马尔采夫（A.F. Maltzeff），他曾向P.S.马克西莫夫通报帕利察涉嫌作为布尔什维克煽动者的活动，以及暂时受雇于上海电力公司、居住在瓦隆路520号的A.F.列夫琴科（A.F.Levchenko），均接受了本人的问询。除了陈述帕利察在受雇于上海电力公司之前，在与他们的闲聊中曾多次表达亲苏态度并提到

he had been absent from Shanghai in either 1930 or 1931 in con-
nection with his military service in the U.S.S.R., they were
unable to furnish any information in support of the above alle-
gation.

Although Palitza is registered with the Russian Emi-
grants Committee at Shanghai, it is possible that he is in pos-
session of a Soviet passport. According to our information his
sister, Miss M.N. Palitza, is a Soviet citizen and, upon her ar-
rival in Shanghai from Harbin in November 1931, made an unsuc-
cessful attempt to register as an emigrant, stating that she had
no documents.

On October 26, 1933, V.N. Palitza called at the Russian
Emigrants Committee, No 6-A Hongkong Road, and requested to be
issued with a certificate of registration, stating that he inten-
ded to proceed to Hongkong. His request was refused on the
ground that he had neither a Chinese passport nor British visa
to enable him to proceed to that port.

Apart from the above nothing is known in this office
regarding this individual.

A: Prokofiev
D.S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

制作人 转呈人

他曾在1930年或1931年因在苏联服兵役而离开上海外，他们无法提供任何支持上述指控的信息。

虽然帕利察已在上海俄国侨民委员会注册，但他可能持有苏联护照。根据我方掌握的信息，他的姐姐M.N.帕利察小姐是苏联公民，她于1931年11月从哈尔滨抵达上海后，曾试图以无证件为由注册为侨民，但未成功。

1933年10月26日，V.N.帕利察前往香港路6-A号俄国侨民委员会，申请签发注册证明书，称他打算前往香港。他的请求被拒绝，理由是他既没有中国护照，也没有英国签证，无法前往该港口。

除上述情况外，本处对该人一无所知。

A: 普罗科菲耶夫
D.S.

特别分支负责人。
（批：82，帕利察目前住在哪里？在哪里工作？）
（签名）
11月2日
W. 普罗科菲耶夫

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
REPORT
Wayside Station,
Date Oct. 25th, 19 33

Subject (in full) Report on some Russians employed at Riverside Power Station.

Made by P.S. 126 V. Maximoff, Forwarded by C.I. Walker.

Sir,
I beg to report the following, whilst on plain cloth duty at River-side Power Station, I was informed by Mr. A.E. Maltzeff (113/28, Avenue Joffre) that a Russian, temporary working in the Shanghai Power Company, by the name of Nickolas Palitza, residing at 587 Avenue Joffre, is known to him as being a Bolchevick agitator, and that Mr. Palitza had been called to U.S.S.R. to serve his military service in 1931 or thereabouts, but returned back to Shanghai shortly after his departure, telling some of his friends(?) that the U.S.S.R. Army gave him the extension off his service on account of his bad health. On hearing this, I made enquiries at the S.P.C. and found that Mr. Palitza had been dismissed the same morning I received the information, the reason of his dismissal was given as "that he had absented himself on the previous night without first obtaining leave".

（批：Information R.C.）
（批：D.C. (Crime)）
（批：AC(SP Br)）
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER / K.B. / OCT 26 / (CRIME BRANCH)）

On the afternoon of 25-10-33, I went to Russian Emigrants Committee to make few enquiries about several Russians recently engaged by S.P.C.; and there I was informed that Mr. Palitza had just applied for a certificate regarding his registration, with the committee as an Emigrant, as he was leaving for Hongkong at 3a.m. on 26-10-33, the secretary of the committee demanded to see Mr. Palitza's British Visa, to that; Mr. Palitza replied that he was going to Hongkong without the British visa and asked the secretary not to delay him as his departure was a matter of importance - however the secretary did not issue the requested certificate, but asked Mr. Palitza to call on the morning of 26-10-33.

Mr. Nickolas Palitza has been registered with R.E. Committee since 11, April, 1930, when he arrived at Shanghai from Harbin, he is single, unemployed and was born on 16, April, 1905.

I am, Sir, Your Obedient Servant.
V.M. Maximoff Ps 126

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号
报告
路边巡捕房，
日期 1933年10月25日

主题（全称） 关于受雇于江边发电站的一些俄籍人员的报告。

制作人 P.S. 126 V. 马克西莫夫， 转呈人 C.I. 沃克。

先生，
谨报告如下：本人在江边发电站执行便衣任务时，A.E.马尔采夫先生（霞飞路113/28号）告知我，一名在上海电力公司临时工作的俄国人，名叫尼古拉斯·帕利察，居住在霞飞路587号，据他所知是一名布尔什维克煽动者；且帕利察先生曾在1931年左右被召往苏联服兵役，但在离开后不久又返回上海，并告诉一些朋友（？）苏联军队因其健康状况不佳而延长了他的服役期。闻此消息后，我向上海电力公司查询，发现帕利察先生在我收到该信息的当天上午已被解雇，解雇理由为“他前一晚在未获准假的情况下擅自缺勤”。

（批：情报 R.C.）
（批：D.C. (刑事)）
（批：助理总监(特别分支)）
（印：副总监 / K.B. / 10月26日 / (刑事科)）

1933年10月25日下午，我前往俄国侨民委员会，就最近被上海电力公司雇用的几名俄籍人员进行了一些查询；在那里我获悉，帕利察先生刚刚向委员会申请了一份关于其作为侨民注册的证明书，因为他将于1933年10月26日凌晨3点离开前往香港，委员会秘书要求查看帕利察先生的英国签证，对此，帕利察先生回答说他将在没有英国签证的情况下前往香港，并请秘书不要耽搁他，因为他的出发事宜重要——然而秘书并未签发所要求的证明书，而是请帕利察先生于1933年10月26日上午再来。

尼古拉斯·帕利察先生自1930年4月11日从哈尔滨抵达上海以来，一直在俄国侨民委员会注册，他单身，失业，出生于1905年4月16日。

先生，我是您顺从的仆人。
V.M. 马克西莫夫 警号 126
